items.statement: Kernel bootstrap and Android home-screen launcher are separate execution domains and cannot share a privileged boot path.
items.feature: Isolated build profiles plus image validation and versioned handoff preparation
items.unknown_behavior: Never treat an Android application as a bootloader or claim CPU handoff before an architecture-specific entry implementation exists.
verification: Kernel profile validates image size, load range and architecture.
Handoff data is independently validated before copying.
Android profile remains separately identified and specification-only.
No CPU jump is claimed by the host contract API.
